mentions.name: PARTTS
mentions.description: A post-apocalyptic real-time transport simulator where the player runs logistics and fleet management for a trucking company hauling cargo and passengers during a zombie outbreak. Jobs unfold in real time, with random events during a job affecting the outcome, job length calculated from the distance between departure and destination, and upcoming driver rest mechanics. The gameplay loop is built around occasionally checking on jobs happening in the background rather than sitting down for long play sessions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
PARTTS - post-apocalyptic real time transport simulator

basically logistics and fleet management for a trucking company that does cargo and passengers, set in a zombie outbreak with events that can happen during a job that affect the outcome. This all happens in real-time, the length of a job is calculated based on the distance between the departure and destination points and soon drivers needing rest will be a factor.
